selection: best validation PSNR (valid split of PanCollection)
train: python train_pancoll.py --model UTeRM-in --dataset qb --device cuda:0 --max_hours 48 --eval_every 2000 --skip S_PAN --tag _skipS_PAN --results_dir results_panbase
train_note: training runs in segments of at most 48 h; continue an interrupted run with the same command plus --resume. The recipe is the method's published one, identical for the three arms.
infer: python scripts/infer.py --method UTeRM --arm s_pan --train-set qb --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/UTeRM/s_pan/qb_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method UTeRM --arm s_pan --train-set qb --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/UTeRM/s_pan/qb_full
runtime_note: upstream code allocates on CUDA inside forward; evaluated on non-overlapping 64x64 tiles (harness.eval_forward).
inference_seed: torch.manual_seed(0) immediately before each test image
